title: A Comprehensive View of the Biases of Toxicity and Sentiment Analysis Methods Towards Utterances with African American English Expressions

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing toxicity and sentiment analysis scores of utterances based on the presence and frequency of African American English (AAE) expressions, utilizing cumulative distribution functions (CDFs), logistic regression with grammatical and linguistic control features, and cosine similarity comparisons of text embeddings to evaluate score divergence on semantically similar sentences.

Evaluating the disparate treatment of texts by measuring how models assign higher toxicity or negative sentiment probabilities to linguistic features heavily associated with the African American community compared to Mainstream American English (MAE).
